tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: First, do you have any specific routines or practices you use to maintain your physical health? If so, what are they?
tasks.sample: Yes, I have two main habits to stay physically healthy. First, I exercise regularly, usually by running or playing basketball for about 30 minutes every other day. This keeps my body strong and gives me more energy. Second, I try to sleep at least seven hours every night. I've noticed that when I get enough sleep, I’m less likely to get sick and I can focus better during the day. These simple routines really help me stay in good physical condition.
tasks.analysis: 中文：首先，你是否有用来维持身体健康的特定习惯或做法？如果有，它们是什么？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Can you describe any dietary choices or habits that you follow to stay healthy? Give details to explain it.
tasks.sample: I have several clear dietary habits. First, I drink a lot of water and avoid sugary drinks like soda. I also try to eat more vegetables and lean protein, such as chicken and fish, instead of too much fried or fast food. I don’t skip breakfast either, because it gives me energy for my morning classes. By balancing my meals and choosing natural foods, I feel healthier and more comfortable throughout the day.
tasks.analysis: 中文：你能描述一下你为了保持健康而遵循的饮食选择或习惯吗？请详细说明。
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: If you could make one significant change to your diet or exercise routine to stay healthy, what would it be? Why would you make that choice?
tasks.sample: If I could make one change, I would add more consistent strength training to my exercise routine. Right now, I mostly do cardio, like running, but I don’t lift weights or do bodyweight exercises regularly. Strength training would help me build muscle, improve my posture, and prevent injuries. It would also make my body stronger overall, so I could keep doing other activities for a long time. That’s why I think this change would be really useful.
tasks.analysis: 中文：如果你可以对自己的饮食或锻炼习惯做出一项重大改变来保持健康，你会做出什么改变？为什么会做出这个选择？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Some people believe that mental health is just as important as physical health, and should be given equal attention. Do you agree or disagree with this viewpoint, why?
tasks.sample: I completely agree that mental health is just as important as physical health. First, if your mind is stressed or tired, you can’t perform well even if your body is healthy. For example, students with high anxiety often struggle to study, no matter how physically fit they are. Second, good mental health supports physical health — people who are emotionally balanced are more likely to exercise, sleep well, and eat properly. So we really should care for both equally.
tasks.analysis: 中文：有些人认为心理健康和身体健康同样重要，应该得到同等的重视。你同意还是不同意这个观点，为什么？
tasks.title: Interview
